hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/mike-roess-gold-head-branch-state-park/experiences-amenities-0#camping ('Each site includes a picnic table, fire ring/grill and potable water'; '20- and 30-amp electrical service is available at all campsites except for sites 57 and 60-67 in the Lakeview campground loop. Sites 16-18, 58 and 59 feature 50-amp service in addition to 20- and 30-amp service.') + Reserve Florida unit details (water hookup on every RV site), read 2026-10-21 in a browser

values.note: 73 campsites in three loops (Sandhill, Turkey Oak, Lakeview) for tents, trailers and motorized campers. Reserve Florida lists 24 'RV or Tent' sites in Lakeview and 14 in Sandhill, 30-55 ft (three take 55 ft), with 3 pull-throughs in Lakeview; Turkey Oak's 17 are listed tent-only while it is closed for renovation (since March 2026). Sites 57 and 60-67 in Lakeview have no electricity.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/mike-roess-gold-head-branch-state-park/experiences-amenities-0#camping ('The park's 73 campsites accommodate tents, trailers and motorized campers') + https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/mike-roess-gold-head-branch-state-park ('Effective March, 2026: The Turkey Oak campground ... is closed for renovations') + Reserve Florida search/grid and search/details for facilities 123, 125, 126 (VehicleLength, PullInTypeName), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/mike-roess-gold-head-branch-state-park/experiences-amenities-0#camping ('A centralized dump station is available'; 'Each campground has its own bathhouse facility with hot showers'; 'A coin-operated washer and dryer are available at the Sandhill and Lakeview bathhouses'), read 2026-10-21

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/mike-roess-gold-head-branch-state-park/experiences-amenities-0#camping ('Reservations can be made up to 11 months in advance. Visit the Florida State Parks reservations website or call 800-326-3521') + Reserve Florida search/place PlaceId 46 Restrictions (MinimumStay 1, MaximumStay 14), read 2026-10-21

note: Campground sites are in a wooded area; the park's lakes are in ravines/sinkholes and sites are not directly on them. The Turkey Oak loop has been closed for renovations since March 2026, and the Little Lake Johnson swimming area since July 6, 2026 (low water) (park page, read 2026-10-21). --Claude
summary: Confirmed reservable on Reserve Florida, 11-month window and 14-night maximum for this park. Added 50-amp electric (at 5 sites; 20/30 at most) with water at every site, 73 sites to 55 ft with pull-throughs, showers/dump/laundry. Fees ($20 + $7 utility) match Reserve Florida's $20 site rate; left as recorded. Not stated: sewer, season, fcfs. Note: added the Turkey Oak renovation closure (one loop, so a note rather than a status).
